title: NBA Sim Clocks & Duration Model (foundation 0.1.0)
description: Authoritative clock rules (period, OT, shot clock, backcourt), resolution + quantization rule, duration sampling distributions for every gameplay micro-segment, and start-reason mode biases that drive possession length in v0.1.0. Frozen alongside docs/foundation/clocks-duration.md (T6).

foundation_version.description: Semver stamp of the duration/clock contract. Must match config/foundation.json#foundation_version.

resolution_seconds.description: Game-clock quantum. All sampled durations are rounded to this resolution per the quantize_rule. Pinned at 0.1 for v0.1.0; changing it is a major foundation_version bump.

quantize_rule.description: JavaScript expression string documenting how a raw sampled delta (seconds) is snapped to the resolution. v0.1.0 freeze (decision M7): Math.round(delta_raw * 10) / 10. The engine evaluates this semantically; the regex here only guards the canonical form.

period_seconds.description: Regulation quarter length: 12:00 = 720 seconds. Pinned for v0.1.0.

overtime_seconds.description: Overtime period length: 5:00 = 300 seconds. Pinned for v0.1.0 (decision M6).

shot_clock_full.description: Full shot clock reset value. Pinned for v0.1.0.

shot_clock_reset.description: Partial shot clock reset value used in the v0.1.0 subset of triggers (see Shot Clock Reset Rules). Pinned for v0.1.0.

backcourt_seconds.description: Time to legally advance past the time line. Pinned for v0.1.0.

last_minute_periods_q1_q2_q3.description: Game clock stops after a made field goal in the final 1:00 of Q1, Q2, and Q3. Pinned true for v0.1.0.

last_two_minutes_q4_ot.description: Game clock stops after a made field goal in the final 2:00 of Q4 and any overtime period. Pinned true for v0.1.0.

durations.$comment: Closed 14-entry catalog for v0.1.0. Uniqueness of `id` and the presence of every documented ID are enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs (todo 9 linter) and by the jq '.durations | length' and per-id jq verification gates; JSON Schema draft-07 has no portable way to pin the exact id set.

id.description: Duration identifier cross-referenced by plays.json (T8). Lowercase snake_case.

distribution.description: Sampling distribution. v0.1.0 freeze: only `uniform` is used; `trunc_normal` is reserved for future tuning and is rejected by the foundation linter until a play explicitly references it.

min.description: Lower bound (seconds). For uniform this is the inclusive min; for trunc_normal it is the truncation floor. Must satisfy min <= max (enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs in todo 9; JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express this without ajv's $data extension, which is intentionally not loaded by ajv-cli strict mode).

max.description: Upper bound (seconds). For uniform this is the exclusive-ish max; for trunc_normal it is the truncation ceiling.

mode.description: Possession mode the engine selects for this start reason (decision M4: only HALFCOURT | TRANSITION in v0.1.0).

align_extra_seconds.description: Extra time added on top of the align_halfcourt duration sample when the possession enters HALFCOURT from a dead-ball start. after_make adds ~1.5s to push mean possession length toward the target ~17s band; transition starts typically use 0.

shot_clock_reset_to.description: For after_offensive_rebound: shot clock resets to clocks.shot_clock_reset (14) per the v0.1.0 subset rule. Pinned at 14.
